video_title: Pat Bev Answers LeBron OR Giannis, Explains How to Guard the Sixers, & Klay Thompson

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his impact on the Minnesota Timberwolves' playoff streak
quotes.excerpt: They haven't missed the playoffs since I got there.
quotes.quote: They haven't missed the playoffs since I got there. Two Western Conference finals. They haven't missed the playoffs from me being there until now. They have not missed the playoffs. I'm not saying it's all me, but I started something in Minnesota for sure.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley's defensive game plan for the Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I'm putting LeBron James and Embiid in every pick-and-roll scenario.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: Offensively, I'm putting LeBron James and Embiid in every pick-and-roll scenario. I'm going to use my offense to be my defense. LeBron's guarding you? You come set this screen. I'm going to put those two in every single defensive scenario that I can. Anytime I see LeBron James, I'm attacking him. I'm getting in the paint. I'm making Embiid help every single time.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: You're going to have to do it again. You're going to have to do it again.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the Milwaukee Bucks' defensive speed and pace
quotes.excerpt: They are the fastest team in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I'm playing so fast. If Indiana meets Philly first round, they're going to be a tough out because of the speed, because of the pace. Only because of the pace. Trust me, I guarded it. They are the fastest team in the NBA. They almost won a championship if Tyler Herro doesn't get hurt. They could have won a championship.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the Miami Heat's need for a veteran point guard
quotes.excerpt: Behind Davion Mitchell, they need a veteran point guard and they need Klay Thompson.
quotes.quote: I like Miami. They need one or two more pieces. They need a point guard. I like Davion Mitchell as a starting point guard, but behind Davion Mitchell, they need a veteran point guard and they need Klay Thompson. A shooter that everyone respects.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on Giannis Antetokounmpo's intelligence and personality
quotes.excerpt: He is one of the smartest people off the court I've ever been around.
quotes.quote: People don't understand how funny Greek really is. He is a real troll. He is a real life troll. He is one of the smartest people off the court I've ever been around. He knows exactly what's going on all the time.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his competitive spirit and role in practice
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to fight for a starting spot.
quotes.quote: I'm trying to fight for a starting spot. So I'm not even going to be a version of the good vet. I am going at this young man. I'm at his neck every day in practice. It might rub people the wrong way, it might help an organization, but I'm still to a point where I'm super, super, super competitive.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his future plans and team-building approach
quotes.excerpt: I want to take teams that are in the middle of the pack and I'm going to bring them up.
quotes.quote: I'm still doing it. I'm still playing basketball. I get a chance to play with a new team in France. I kind of found my niche. I'm not going to do the EuroLeague, I'm not going to do the big clubs. I want to take teams that are in the middle of the pack that want to go up and I'm going to bring them up. And that's my niche.
